county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a record of monthly fire drills conducted for licensing to review.

top_violation_types.title: Designating Director (26 TAC §744.201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a designated site director.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Space and Equipment - Age-appropriate Seating, Tables (26 TAC §744.2051(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child 5 years of age fell and fractured their arm after climbing onto a high backless metal stool to play an arcade game.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §744.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on DFPS findings, good judgement was not used when a caregiver exposed the child by compelling and encouraging inappropriate behavior when entering a  storage closet with the child and turning off the lights.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §744.3113(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not conducted a monthly playground maintenance check since October.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with food allergies did not have a food allergy plan.

top_violation_types.title: Director - Multi-Site Operations (26 TAC §744.1003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not submitted all required documentation for a site director.
